input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII is entirely one-sided: only Licensor benefits from the consequential-damages exclusion, and only Licensor's aggregate liability is capped — at one half of amounts paid, i.e. well below six months' fees. Licensee's liability is left unlimited and is compounded by the broad Licensee-only indemnity in Article XII, with no super-cap or carve-outs in either direction. That is walk-away territory under the rule (customer uncapped while vendor capped; vendor cap below six months' fees; indemnities inside/outside with no mutual carve-out structure), so it fails the fallback of a mutual 12-month cap with carve-outs. Our redline edits only the two operative sentences: it makes the exclusion and the cap mutual, sets the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and places confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, with Licensee's payment obligations excluded from capped "damages". We left the surrounding all-caps disclaimer language (including the Licensor IP-infringement disclaimer, which is addressed under the IP indemnity rule) and paragraph (c) untouched.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap and damages exclusion mutual, set the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and place standard carve-outs outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion mutual and reset the cap to the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, since as drafted our liability is unlimited while Licensor's is limited to half of amounts paid. Indemnification, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Licensee's payment obligations are not capped damages.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.
